description: Windows Dynamic Island for tracking Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor agent sessions, usage limits, permission requests, and replies.
notes: Downloads the publisher's two official standalone release binaries directly. nook.exe and nook-hook.exe must remain side by side; the application discovers the relay executable beside its own EXE and copies it to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Nook\bin at runtime.
This manifest does not run the NSIS setup. The release's SHA256SUMS.txt and GitHub Release asset digests were checked for both binaries.

Nook stores preferences under %APPDATA%\Nook and its relay/log under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Nook. Claude Code and Cursor hook entries are written only after an explicit action in Nook; uninstalling this Scoop package does not remove those entries. Remove Nook's hooks from the app before uninstalling if they are no longer wanted.
